verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 7.21
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 7.21

verses.pali: 3. Vajjisattakavagga
verses.english: 3. The Vajji Seven

verses.pali: Sārandadasutta
verses.english: At Sārandada

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā vesāliyaṁ viharati sārandade cetiye.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Vesālī, at the Sārandada Shrine.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu. Ekamantaṁ nisinne kho te licchavī bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then several Licchavis went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and the Buddha said to these Licchavis:

verses.pali: “satta vo, licchavī, aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi.
verses.english: “Licchavis, I will teach you these seven principles that prevent decline.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te licchavī bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Katame ca, licchavī, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
verses.english: “And what are the seven principles that prevent decline?

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī abhiṇhaṁ sannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis meet frequently and have many meetings,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis meet in harmony, leave in harmony, and carry on their business in harmony,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī apaññattaṁ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṁ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis don’t make new decrees or abolish existing decrees, but undertake and follow the ancient Vajjian traditions as they have been decreed,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṁ vajjimahallakā te sakkarissanti garuṁ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṁ maññissanti;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis honor, respect, esteem, and venerate Vajjian elders, and think them worth listening to,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okassa pasayha vāsessanti;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis don’t forcibly abduct the women or girls of the clans and make them live with them,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṁ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca tāni sakkarissanti garuṁ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca dinnapubbaṁ katapubbaṁ dhammikaṁ baliṁ no parihāpessanti;
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis honor, respect, esteem, and venerate the Vajjian shrines, whether inner or outer, not neglecting the proper spirit-offerings that were given and made in the past,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṁvihitā bhavissati:
verses.english: As long as the Vajjis organize proper protection, shelter, and security for perfected ones, so that

verses.pali: ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṁ āgaccheyyuṁ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṁ vihareyyun’ti;
verses.english: more perfected ones might come to the realm and those already here may live in comfort,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, licchavī, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu vajjī sandississanti;
verses.english: As long as these seven principles that prevent decline last among the Vajjis, and as long as the Vajjis are seen following them,

verses.pali: vuddhiyeva, licchavī, vajjīnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti.
verses.english: they can expect growth, not decline.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
